description: Main window. Note core:window:allow-start-dragging: the window is titleBarStyle Overlay, so the webview covers the native title bar and there is no native strip to grab — dragging goes through data-tauri-drag-region, which calls startDragging(). That is NOT part of core:window:default (a read-only query set), so without it the window cannot be moved at all. dialog:allow-save is for exporting a note to a .md file — the write itself goes through the app's own export_note command rather than tauri-plugin-fs, so there is no general file-write capability in the app.
